title: Index-level volatility premium via put-write methodology indices vs market/cash, with conservative implementation drag
mechanism: Short-put option-writing on SPX monetizes the volatility risk premium (implied variance minus realized variance, plus equity-beta risk compensation). The Cboe PUT methodology index documents the gross premium: it beat cash by +8.7%/yr in development (2020-08..2023-12) and +12.3%/yr in validation (2024). A conservative, predeclared implementation-drag stack (theoretical-index tracking, collateral yield shortfall, admin/tax, deploy/turnover costs) converts this into an executable estimate. The falsified claim is that this premium is market-relative executable alpha: in both windows the drag-adjusted book delivered positive cash-relative returns but NEGATIVE excess over the SPX-direction market proxy, because the book is a high-beta equity position plus premium, and 2024's strongly trending bull market made the full-equity benchmark unmatchable by a write-protected book.

regime_variant_unused.rule: prior month-end VIX > trailing 126-day median => 100% PUT else 100% market
regime_variant_unused.not_selected_because: lower development Sharpe (0.617 vs 0.965) and higher drawdown

signal_timing: T2/T4: static allocation, next-bar daily index returns. T3 (not selected): month-end VIX close vs trailing 126-day VIX median computed at month-end m, position applied from m+1 through month m+1; no same-day signal execution. All returns use date-t index closes; positions formed from information available at t-1 close or earlier.
cost_model: Daily executable estimate = w_put*PUT_return + w_mkt*(RF+Mkt-RF) - turnover*30bps - x_opt*(15+25+20)bps/252; 2x stress doubles variable drags and turnover costs. Cash benchmark = RF - 24bps/252 daily; market benchmark = RF+Mkt-RF - 10bps/252 daily. Exact application in run.py COSTS and returns.csv cost column.

benchmark.named: SPX-direction market proxy (FF3 Mkt-RF + RF, unlevered buy-and-hold, 10bps/yr friction)
benchmark.blocked_leg: QQQ/NDX - Cboe keyless IXIC endpoint returns HTTP 403 (attempt logged in data/PROVENANCE.json); no lawful keyless NDX/QQQ history is available in this workspace, so the QQQ comparison is BLOCKED and not reported
benchmark.rationale: A put-write book is a long-equity book minus put protection; its economic benchmark is the unlevered index it writes against, not cash

first_falsification_gate.predeclared: Development gate first: drag-adjusted put-write must show positive cumulative benchmark-excess return over the market-proxy benchmark in development; if passed, the frozen validation read required positive validation net Sharpe above the named benchmark with nonnegative 2x-cost cumulative excess.
first_falsification_gate.result: FAIL at the development stage already (excess -1.9%/yr, HAC t=-0.49, sign negative, indistinguishable from zero); the single frozen validation read confirmed the direction (validation excess -8.4%/yr; -9.1%/yr at 2x stress).

leakage_checks.next_bar_execution: positions never use same-bar information: T3 regime signal at month-end m applies from m+1; static variants have no signal to leak
leakage_checks.lookahead_probe: T3 with next-month signal raises dev Sharpe 0.617->1.161, confirming the lagged implementation is genuinely lagged
leakage_checks.embargo_compliance: run.py fails closed on --end > 2024-12-31 without QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1; verified exit code 2; wave one never set the flag; all artifacts contain only <= 2024-12-31 dates
leakage_checks.data_censoring: PUT/BXM source files contain post-2024 rows (published index history runs to 2026-08-28); every computation filters dates to <= 2024-12-31 before metrics; returns.csv last row is 2024-12-31
leakage_checks.input_integrity: manifest-tracked inputs re-hashed at runtime against manifest SHA256s; collection checksums recorded in data/PROVENANCE.json

risks: The 'executable' estimate multiplies a methodology index by a predeclared drag stack; real option writers face basis risk vs theoretical prints, contract-size indivisibility, and pin risk that a multiplicative stack cannot capture - the true executable book could be worse than modeled
Market-proxy benchmark uses FF3 value-weighted Mkt-RF rather than SPX total return; a cap-weighted proxy is the closest lawful keyless stand-in
QQQ/NDX comparison blocked (Cboe IXIC endpoint 403 at fetch time); no conclusion on the NASDAQ-leg premium
Single validation year, exceptional bull regime; the falsification is sign-robust (negative in both windows) but the magnitude is regime-dependent
Methodology-index option pricing (theoretical quotes at daily close) overstates achievable fills in fast markets; the 2020-08 start avoids the worst 2020-03 period but this optimism remains
No claim is made that index history demonstrates executable alpha; this dossier explicitly does NOT conclude the premium is harvestable net of realistic frictions
2025-2026 published-index behavior was not read (embargo); decay claims would require the evaluator's licensed historical-confirmation run
next_experiment: Do not pursue further index-multiplication variants; if lawful bounded option data ever becomes available, the open question is premium DECOMPOSITION (SR premium vs beta compensation vs collapse timing), not another drag-model backtest.
